title: Subtle check-then-act directory creation race condition
diff:
@@ -2,4 +2,5 @@
 
 def ensure_cache_directory(cache_dir: str) -> None:
     """Ensure the target cache directory exists."""
-    os.makedirs(cache_dir, exist_ok=True)
+    if not os.path.exists(cache_dir):
+        os.makedirs(cache_dir)

ground_truth.description: Check-then-act pattern creates TOCTOU race condition in concurrent environments; use exist_ok=True.
